description: Display-name-based minimal EMOS metadata - all names derived from display names

naming_conventions.source_of_truth: Display names are the primary source - everything else is derived
naming_conventions.derivation_order: Display Name → Folder Name → Class Name → File Name → ID
naming_conventions.ids: snake_case derived from display names with special case handling

derivation_rules.display_to_folder: Remove special chars, PascalCase words (with special case overrides)
derivation_rules.display_to_id: Convert to snake_case, handle special abbreviations

databases.COD: Crystallography Open Database - open-access collection of crystal structures
databases.Alexandria: Alexandria PBE - DFT database for materials properties
databases.Mathub3d: MatHub-3d - first-principles materials repository with 3D structures for high-throughput thermoelectric research
databases.JarvisDFT: JARVIS-DFT - NIST computational materials database with electronic, optical, and solar cell properties
databases.AFLOW: AFLOW - Automatic FLOW database for computational materials science with rich mechanical, thermal, and electronic properties

generators.MatterGen: Base Model: Unconditional diffusion model for general inorganic crystal structure generation (mattergen_base)
generators.MatterGen: MP-20 Base: Unconditional base model trained on the MP-20 dataset for crystal structure generation (mp_20_base)
generators.MatterGen: Chemical System: Conditional model for generating structures within a specified chemical system (chemical_system)
generators.MatterGen: Chemical System + Stability: Conditional model for generating structures within a chemical system with target energy above hull (chemical_system_energy_above_hull)
generators.MatterGen: DFT Band Gap: Property-conditioned model for generating structures with a target DFT band gap (dft_band_gap)
generators.MatterGen: Magnetic Density: Property-conditioned model for generating structures with a target DFT magnetic density (dft_mag_density)
generators.MatterGen: Magnetic Density + HHI: Multi-property-conditioned model targeting magnetic density and Herfindahl-Hirschman elemental scarcity index (dft_mag_density_hhi_score)
generators.MatterGen: Bulk Modulus: Property-conditioned model for generating structures with a target ML-predicted bulk modulus (ml_bulk_modulus)
generators.MatterGen: Space Group: Symmetry-conditioned model for generating structures in a target crystallographic space group (space_group)

predictors.MatterSim: Universal neural network potential for materials simulation
predictors.SynthNN: Synthesis Neural Network for synthesizability prediction
predictors.GBFS: Pretrained predictors from GBFS workflow, implemented in Python
predictors.GBFS-2D: Pretrained GBFS workflow predictors specialized for 2D layered materials

materials_exploration.Database Extractor: Extract and analyze specific material properties and data from integrated databases

electronics_application.Advanced Characterization: Advanced characterization techniques for electronic materials evaluation
